beat_plan: Establish: build a numbered image sequence around one lead frame
Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail

direction.camera: Guide attention with contact sheet; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: build a numbered image sequence around one lead frame; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with archive numbering; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with documentary restraint.
direction.lighting: neutral photographic light; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: archival print and black mount; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around measured crop; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use contact sheet,archive numbering,photographic rhythm,small annotation,measured crop,documentary restraint as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
